title: अष्टाङ्गसंग्रह
summary: Vāgbhaṭa's Aṣṭāṅga Saṅgraha studied verse by verse: Sūtrasthāna chapters 1 to 5, Śārīrasthāna chapters 1 to 12 and Kalpasthāna chapters 1 to 8, with Devanagari text, word split, Hindi and English, memory aids, pictures and six questions per unit.
source_disclaimer: पाठ: १८८८ का मराठी-मुद्रित संस्करण, खराब स्कैन से डिजिटाइज़ किया गया; कुछ पाठ अस्पष्ट या दूषित है। हिन्दी और English: AI-रचित, AI-समीक्षित; विद्वान् से जाँच शेष।

gram_overrides.उपदेक्ष्यते: प्र.पु. ए.व. लृट् आत्मने. उप-√दिश् (कर्तृ-अर्थ ‘सिखाएगा’, या कर्मवाच्य ‘सिखाया जाएगा’; कर्मवाच्य के साथ तम् द्वितीया असामान्य)

chapters.title: आयुष्कामीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 1, Āyuṣkāmīya: the invocation, the sages' request, the line of teaching from Brahmā, the aim of long life, and the plan of the whole work.

chapters.title: शिष्योपनयनीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 2, Śiṣyopanayanīya: the qualities of teacher and pupil, how the physician learns, and the four parts of treatment.

chapters.title: दिनचर्या
chapters.summary: Chapter 3, Dinacaryā: the daily routine and conduct from waking onward.

chapters.title: ऋतुचर्या
chapters.summary: Chapter 4, Ṛtucaryā: seasonal regimen, diet and conduct.

chapters.title: रोगानुत्पादनीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 5, Rogānutpādanīya: not letting disease arise, and the urges that should not be held back.

chapters.title: पुत्रकामीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 1, Putrakāmīya: ages for marriage and conception, śukra and ārtava with their defects and treatment, the fertile period, rites for a son, and what shapes the child.

chapters.title: गर्भावक्रान्ति
chapters.summary: Chapter 2, Garbhāvakrānti: formation and sex of the embryo, signs of conception, month-by-month growth and longings, birth, congenital defects, and care of the pregnant woman.

chapters.title: गर्भोपचरणीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 3, Garbhopacaraṇīya: monthly diet and care in pregnancy, the delivery room and labour, retained foetus and placenta, and the regimen after delivery.

chapters.title: गर्भव्यापद्
chapters.summary: Chapter 4, Garbhavyāpad: mishaps of pregnancy: bleeding, miscarriage, the stunted foetus, the dead or malpresented foetus and its extraction, after-care, and monthly remedies.

chapters.title: अङ्गविभाग
chapters.summary: Chapter 5, Aṅgavibhāga: the body's parts and their origin from the elements and parents, mental qualities, and counts of skins, organs, bones, joints, muscles and fluids.

chapters.title: सिराविभाग
chapters.summary: Chapter 6, Sirāvibhāga: the vessels and those not to be pierced, the dhamanīs, the channels (srotas), the digestive fire, and how food nourishes the dhātus.

chapters.title: मर्मविभाग
chapters.summary: Chapter 7, Marmavibhāga: the 107 vital points, their sites and the effect of injury, their division by tissue and outcome, their sizes, and marma injury.

chapters.title: प्रकृतिभेदीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 8, Prakṛtibhedīya: the seven constitutions and their marks, stages of age, strength and the eight sāras, body measures, and the marks of a long-lived body.

chapters.title: विकृताङ्गविज्ञानीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 9, Vikṛtāṅgavijñānīya: riṣṭa, the sudden change of the body's natural state that foretells death, in colour, shadow, senses, voice and touch.

chapters.title: विकृतेहाविज्ञानीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 10, Vikṛtehāvijñānīya: signs of approaching death in perverted perception, behaviour, breathing and mind, with time-limits of survival.

chapters.title: विकृतव्याधिविज्ञानीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 11, Vikṛtavyādhivijñānīya: the fatal signs of individual diseases, the patient's ominous gestures, and the failure of well-tried medicine.

chapters.title: दूतादिविज्ञानीय
chapters.summary: Chapter 12, Dūtādivijñānīya: prognosis from the messenger, omens on the way, dreams that foretell disease or recovery, and the close of the Śārīrasthāna.

chapters.title: वमनकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 1, Vamanakalpa: madana (emetic nut) as the chief emetic, its collection and storage, its many preparations, and the other emetic fruits and their uses.

chapters.title: विरेचनकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 2, Virecanakalpa: trivṛt (turpeth) as the chief purgative, its collection and preparations, and the other purgative drugs with their formulas.

chapters.title: वमनविरेचनव्यापत्सिद्धि
chapters.summary: Chapter 3, Vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhi: what goes wrong in emesis and purgation (failure, wrong direction, excess and their complications) and how each is treated.

chapters.title: बस्तिकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 4, Bastikalpa: decoction (nirūha) enemas for different doṣas and conditions, their drug groups, measures and how they are prepared.

chapters.title: सिद्धबस्तिकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 5, Siddhabastikalpa: the named proven enemas, yāpana and milk enemas, aphrodisiac enemas, the harms of overuse, and unctuous enemas with their oils.

chapters.title: बस्तिव्यापत्सिद्धिकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 6, Bastivyāpatsiddhikalpa: the twelve mishaps of enemas from too little or too much, their signs, and the treatment of each.

chapters.title: स्नेहव्यापदिकासिद्धि
chapters.summary: Chapter 7, Snehavyāpadikāsiddhi: the mishaps of the unctuous enema, faults of nozzle, bag, bed and physician, after-care diet and things to avoid.

chapters.title: भेषजकल्प
chapters.summary: Chapter 8, Bheṣajakalpa: lands and their drugs, gathering and storing drugs, the five preparations, cooking medicated ghee and oil, and the weights and measures.
